title: session recording chunk
description: One chunk of the session recording of one page load, which a page sends to the collector (POST /v1/session) only while the visitor consents to recording. The body is this JSON as gzip, or as plain text for the last chunk of a page that closes, without a content type, at most 512 KiB as sent and 2 MiB as text. The events are rrweb's, with typed text masked and nothing recorded inside the parts the page blocks; the clicks say where a click landed for the heat map, as a share of the part of the page it landed in. The collector refuses a chunk with anything else (edge/src/session-chunk.js).

code.description: A random UUID made for one recording, the same in each of its chunks. The browser keeps it 30 days to delete the recording.

seq.description: The order of the chunk in its recording, from 0.

type.description: rrweb's event type: DomContentLoaded, Load, FullSnapshot, IncrementalSnapshot, Meta, Custom or Plugin.

data.description: What rrweb recorded, as it wrote it.

region.description: The part of the page the click landed in: a section by its id, the header, the footer, the privacy notice or dialog, or anything else, measured against the window.

viewport.description: The range of the window's width, in CSS pixels, when the click happened.

x.description: How far across its part the click landed, from the left.

y.description: How far down its part the click landed, from the top.

at.description: Milliseconds from the start of the recording.
